Flow A: Case Type=Downtime -> Priority=High

Flow C: Tier=Platinum -> SLA=4 Hours
Flow D: Subject has "security" -> flag

caption: Each flow looks reasonable alone — five separate places the same object's logic lives.

code:
One Case Before-Save flow:
  Decision -> Downtime: Priority=High
  Decision -> Phone: assign Queue
  Decision -> Platinum: SLA=4 Hours
  Decision -> Security: flag
  Decision -> Escalated: notify
caption: Same five business rules — one place to read, one place to debug, one predictable order.
